environment_setting: Country B, City X, where public protests and demonstrations are frequent, requiring police to follow strict protocols to prevent serious disruptions
norm_base: Public Officials Police failing to follow guidance on serious disruption prevention orders Administrative/disciplinary consequences

character_profile.name: Officer John Smith
character_profile.goal: maintain public order during a large protest

legitimate.legitimate_action: strictly following guidance on serious disruption prevention orders
legitimate.benefits: ensures public safety, avoids administrative/disciplinary consequences, maintains professional reputation
legitimate.costs: requires significant effort and coordination, potential personal stress

illegal.illegal_action: failing to follow guidance on serious disruption prevention orders
illegal.benefits: avoids immediate stress and effort, reduces workload
illegal.costs: administrative/disciplinary consequences, potential harm to public safety, damage to professional reputation

character_profile.name: Sergeant Emily Davis
character_profile.goal: ensure her team follows all protocols during the protest

legitimate.legitimate_action: ensuring Officer John Smith and the team follow guidance on serious disruption prevention orders
legitimate.benefits: maintains public safety, avoids administrative/disciplinary consequences for the team, upholds department's reputation
legitimate.costs: requires constant supervision and effort, potential conflict with team members

illegal.illegal_action: ignoring whether Officer John Smith and the team follow guidance on serious disruption prevention orders
illegal.benefits: reduces personal workload, avoids immediate stress
illegal.costs: administrative/disciplinary consequences for herself and the team, potential harm to public safety

character_profile.name: Protester Alex Carter
character_profile.goal: ensure the protest gains maximum visibility without causing harm

legitimate.legitimate_action: cooperating with police to ensure the protest remains peaceful and within legal boundaries
legitimate.benefits: avoids legal consequences, ensures protest message is heard, builds positive public perception
legitimate.costs: requires compromise and coordination with authorities, potential dissatisfaction from more radical protestors

illegal.illegal_action: escalating the protest to cause serious disruption
illegal.benefits: gains immediate attention and visibility for the cause
illegal.costs: legal consequences, potential harm to public safety, damage to the cause's reputation
